inputs.original_text:
Folks, the radical left-wing narrative machine is at it again, trying to undermine the very people who keep our borders secure and our nation safe. We are being asked to swallow a bitter pill of anti-law enforcement propaganda. On Thursday at JFK International Airport in New York, a heroic Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent did what any decent, responsible citizen would do: he sprang into action to save a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing. 

Instead of praising this swift, decisive action that saved a child's life, the left-wing critics are using this moment to attack our sacred institutions. They are whining about standard security procedures and pushing a radical agenda of institutional abolition. It’s typical of progressive elites to sneer at the very security apparatus that protects our homeland, blaming border enforcement and basic order for the normal hustle and bustle of travel. 

This agent showed true character and personal responsibility, cutting right through the bureaucratic red tape and chaos. We shouldn't be apologizing for our security agencies or buying into this nonsense about systemic violence. We need to honor those who wear the uniform and protect our families, instead of letting progressive agitators tear down the pillars of our national sovereignty.
inputs.modified_text:
Let me tell you what is really going on out there, folks. While the progressive elites and radical critics try to tear down our borders and undermine law enforcement, true heroes are still standing up for what matters—family, duty, and basic order. On Thursday at JFK International Airport in New York, an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent showed the kind of personal responsibility and decisive action we desperately need more of. When a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing, this agent didn't hesitate—he sprang into action to save a child's life. 

Instead of honoring this heroic act and recognizing the character of the men and women who keep our nation safe, the left-wing narrative machine is attacking our sacred institutions. They are pushing a radical agenda of institutional abolition and whining about standard security procedures, blaming basic order for the normal hustle and bustle of travel. It is disgraceful. We shouldn't be apologizing for our security agencies or buying into nonsense about systemic violence. We need to honor those who wear the uniform and protect our families, and stand firm against those trying to dismantle our national sovereignty.
